chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon him), who said:
The third Adhan on the day of Friday is an innovation.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the third Adhan on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the third Adhan on Friday as a bid'ah (innovation), reflecting the Shia scholarly view that while the first two Adhans are established traditions, the third is a later addition not rooted in the Prophet's practice. This ruling underscores the principle of adhering strictly to prophetic precedents in ritual worship, distinguishing between authentic sunnah and customary accretions. It serves as a key reference in fiqh discussions regarding the structure and timing of the Friday congregational prayer.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Khazzaz, from Hafs Bin Giyas, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The third Azan on the day of Friday is an innovation’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz from Hafs ibn al- Ghiyath who has said the following: “Ja‘far, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that his father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A third Adhan on Friday is a heretical invention.’”
